snippet.title: Create a Winning Job Search Strategy while Social Distancing
snippet.description:
The job market is changing rapidly due to company and industry-wide responses to the Coronavirus. If your job search strategy consists mainly of applying for jobs online, there is much more that you can be doing to increase your chances of landing a new job. Most people approach job searching reactively. They see a posting and react by applying.

In this webinar, we show you strategies for networking, relationship building, & personal branding designed to increase your chances of getting employee referrals (the current top method for landing interviews). Some of these strategies may also lead to employers/recruiters reaching out to you and landing interviews without ever applying

snippet.title: Job Seeking During COVID-19: How to continue Career Growth in Turbulent Times
snippet.description:
In light of the current global events of COVID-19, we are now facing unprecedented times for most the first in our lifetime. With all the economic and social changes going on around us, new questions arise regarding the future in general, but more importantly your individual future when it comes to the future job markets.

Questions arise around how do we weather this storm? What can we do to stay active and stay focused? What adjustments need to be taken to best match today’s society?

Its important to remember that life must go on, so we can either choose to go into inaction or we can choose to get fired up and stay focused on the next steps we take. Join us for this webinar as we have a discussion on some of the top strategies and actions to take to not only survive but thrive during these turbulent times.

snippet.title: Introducing the Growth Product Manager Nanodegree Program
snippet.description:
Learn More: https://www.udacity.com/course/growth-product-manager-nanodegree--nd037

Hone specialized Product Management skills in growth strategy. Lead experimentation and data-driven decision-making in your organization to drive products to reach the next level of scale, impact, and profitability. The full program will be available in June 2020, but get a headstart on the content with the first course, Growth and Acquisition Strategy!

snippet.title: TRANSFERABLE SKILLS - Add an Edge to your Job Search
snippet.description:
Transferable skills are a key component in a job search. They allow job seekers to demonstrate flexibility, diversity, and employability by showing how their skills “transfer” from one job to the next. Including transferable skills on a resume is a helpful tool for those who are:

- Changing job titles
- Moving to a different career path
- Little to no relevant work experience
- Returning to the workforce after a break

In this webinar, we will discuss the importance and role of Transferable Skills in a Job search. Career Coach Meera will provide an overview of who will benefit from employing transferable skills in their search and what are the top desired skills that can help in landing a job.

snippet.title: JUMPING SHIP: Strategies for making a Career Transition
snippet.description:
Have you been thinking of jumping ship from your current role to transition into something new? Does the idea of making this transition sound exciting, but also a little scary? Watch this webinar to learn strategies you can use to successfully position yourself for the transition into a new role.

Career Coach Angela shares tips and tools to assist you in making this jump with confidence and success! We start by helping you to identify your target role and gain deeper insights into the job requirements. Then, we lead you through a self-assessment to assist you in analyzing your strengths, gaps, and transferable skills.

snippet.title: Samantha Huang on Investing in AI & Autonomous Driving: Udacity AI for Business Leaders Webinar
snippet.description:
Learn more about the AI for Business Leaders Executive Program: https://www.udacity.com/course/ai-for-business-leaders--nd054

In the third interview in our AI for Business Leaders Webinar Series, Samantha Huang, Principal at BMW I Ventures, shares her experience with AI strategy initiatives including investing in AI companies, Approximate Dynamic Programming and why it's the next-gen of reinforcement learning, logistical optimization, industries well suited for AI, the ethics of AI and worker displacement, and much more!

Samantha Huang is a Principal at BMW i Ventures, which is a EUR 500M fund that invests in startups in the mobility ecosystem. At BMW i Ventures, Samantha focuses on investments across autonomous driving, AI and big data, Industry 4.0, and digital car and automotive cloud. Samantha previously worked at SK Telecom Ventures and Robert Bosch Venture Capital. She also worked as Lead Researcher at the Rock Center for Corporate Governance at Stanford University for research projects centered on the intersection of entrepreneurship, immigration, and women-in-tech. She holds a J.D. from Berkeley Law School and an MA in history from Stanford University.

snippet.title: Praful Krishna on Implementing AI in Fortune 500 Companies: Udacity AI for Business Leaders Webinar
snippet.description:

In the fifth interview in our AI for Business Leaders Webinar Series, Praful Krishna, CEO of Coseer, a company that helps Fortune 500 companies automate their workflows, shares how to assess potential AI implementations to maximize ROI, the investment required for AI systems, how to determine the right AI use cases, using virtuous cycles of trust to get backing for AI projects, how to make AI go viral in an organization, and much more!
 
Praful has 10+ years solving real world problems with AI. Now, as founder and CEO of Coseer, an award-winning AI company specializing in enterprise search, he helps Fortune 500 companies & Government automate complex workflows. Praful started Coseer after a career with a hedge fund and a turnaround CEO role. He is an alum of McKinsey, Harvard, and IIT.

snippet.title: Gautam Khera on Utilizing AI Technology in R&D: Udacity AI for Business Leaders Webinar Series
snippet.description:
Learn more about the AI for Business Leaders Executive Program: https://www.udacity.com/course/ai-for-business-leaders--nd054

In the second interview in our AI for Business Leaders Webinar Series, Gautam Khera, Senior Global Director of Technical R&D at Western Digital, shares his experience with AI strategy initiatives over the course of his career, the most fulfilling parts of his role, his experience with AI implementation to aid business and research goals, how to utilize machine learning to get insights from volumes of data, outlier & anomaly detection, quantifying ROI from AI implementation and much more!

Dr. Gautam Khera has held engineering and executive leadership roles in the hi-tech manufacturing space with various Fortune 500 companies. Having developed and launched nearly 20 B2B data storage products through the full product life-cycle, Gautam has a holistic industry view, living at the center of product, technology, and manufacturing. His scope has included advanced analytics, big data, and AI. Through a 20 year journey navigating this space he is a thought leader and results-delivering business leader, using advanced analytics to improve time-to-learning, performance, quality and cost. Gautam attended Carleton College, received a Ph.D. in Physics from the University of Minnesota and the Ignite/PRIE Certificate from Stanford University Graduate School of Business.

snippet.title: Alex Ermolaev on AI in Healthcare: Udacity AI for Business Leaders Webinar
snippet.description:
Learn more about the AI for Business Leaders Executive Program: https://www.udacity.com/course/ai-for-business-leaders--nd054

In the fourth interview in our AI for Business Leaders Webinar Series, Alex Ermolaev, Director of AI at ChangeHealthcare, shares his experience implementing AI projects for the company, how he got into AI, what his day-to-day looks like, how they apply AI to all their business units, when AI is better than human insight and vice-versa, when it is necessary to implement, and much more!
 
Alex Ermolaev is a Director of AI at Change Healthcare. He has more than 20 years’ experience building business software companies by combining deep market insights with high-performance teams, clever product road maps, focused product development and effective go-to-market execution.

Alex has an extensive AI background, including working at Bell Labs on Expert Systems and Natural Language Processing; collaborating on multiple startups where he explored object detection, ads/brand detection, drone navigation, and self-driving; and at Nvidia, where he was instrumental in deep learning, AI platforms/tools, cyber, fraud, and enterprise AI.

He has helped build several billion-dollar businesses from scratch at some of the world’s largest tech companies, including Microsoft’s entry into the business apps market and Nvidia’s entry into AI platforms. He also built two startups on his own and advised nearly two dozen others.

Alex, a frequent speaker about “all things AI” at top universities, technology companies, and conferences, hold a Master’s in “Economic Cybernetics” from Plekhanov Academy in Moscow, and an MBA from the University of Chicago.

snippet.title: Sebastian Thrun on the Future of AI in Business: Udacity AI for Business Leaders Webinar
snippet.description:
Learn more about the AI for Business Leaders Executive Program: https://www.udacity.com/course/ai-for-business-leaders--nd054

In the first interview in our AI for Business Leaders Webinar Series, Sebastian Thrun, founder of Udacity and leader of the Google Brain project for deep learning and natural language processing, shares why it is a strategic imperative to take advantage of AI technology today, and how to approach AI transformation in your business.

Sebastian Thrun is a scientist, educator, inventor, and entrepreneur. As the Founder, President, and Executive Chairman of Udacity, Sebastian’s mission is to democratize education by providing lifelong learning to millions of students worldwide. He is also the founder of Google X, where he led projects including the Self-Driving Car, Google Glass, and more.

Previously, he led the Stanford Racing Team whose robot “Stanley” won the DARPA Grand Challenge. Sebastian has been named the 5th Most Creative Person in Business (Fast Company), among the 50 Smartest People in Tech (Fortune), and highlighted in 50 Best Inventions of 2010 (Time). He is the first recipient of the inaugural Smithsonian American Ingenuity Award for Education, and is also featured in the recent film Lo & Behold: Reveries of the Connected World by award-winning writer and director Werner Herzog.
